expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The file explicitly labels placeholders: “`【】` 是必须替换的内容” and uses “【已签约X家客户 / 月流水X万 / 留存X% / 已上线X个月】”; financial cells are blank.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: Asks “做什么：一句话，你为谁解决什么问题？” and “到哪一步了：想法 / Demo / 已上线 / 有收入？”; proposes “建议先出一页纸摘要”.
